# Support

## Questions and help

For usage questions and troubleshooting, first check the [README](../README.md) and [open issues](https://github.com/alexiszamanidis/vscode-git-worktrees/issues) for existing answers.

If your question has not been answered, [open an issue](https://github.com/alexiszamanidis/vscode-git-worktrees/issues/new) with:

-   The extension version and VS Code version.
-   Your operating system and Git version.
-   The command or workflow you were using.
-   Relevant logs, screenshots, and reproduction steps.

For suspected security vulnerabilities, follow the process in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) instead of opening a public issue.
